plugins.name: itr-tax
plugins.description: Expert assistant for filing an Indian ITR-2 under the new tax regime via the online e-filing wizard, for a salaried taxpayer with capital gains and foreign assets/income (RSU/ESPP/ETF/dividends + FTC/Form 67). Covers Schedule S/OS/CG/112A/FSI/TR/FA/AL, AIS/TIS/26AS validation, portal CSV uploads, and a pre-submission multi-model JSON audit.

plugins.name: parallel-reel-creator
plugins.description: Creates Instagram-ready 9:16 vertical Reels (1080x1920) combining a YouTube reference video and a local video recording (e.g. GoPro, phone camera). Supports sequential comparison mode (reference plays while recreation is still, then recreation plays while reference is still), simultaneous side-by-side or stacked playback, custom timestamp slicing, and flexible audio routing.

plugins.name: expedition-documentary-creator
plugins.description: Creates broadcast-grade 4K expedition documentaries (NatGeo / BBC / Vox style) for public YouTube upload from GoPro and mobile/Google Photos videos using commercial-safe multilingual neural voices (UK/US English, Hindi, Bangla, and Odia IndicF5-MLX). Enforces zero-human-face shot selection, STFT voice-suppressed surrounding audio (retaining car, water, wind, and nature), clean large-font 4K Chapter Geographic Cards, and strict YouTube Multi-Language Audio (MLA) alignment.

plugins.name: youtube-custom-voice-player
plugins.description: Overdubs an existing video already uploaded to YouTube into personal and sports commentary voices (neil, nasser, atherton, shastri, tony, holding, attenborough, bear_hindi) without uploading personal/celebrity voices to YouTube. Suppresses the YouTube video's voice while retaining surrounding ambient sound and generates a hostable Custom HTML5 + YouTube IFrame API Sync Player.
